primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.
